main.description: Changes the asking account's preferences, as the appview keeps them: each one given takes the place of the one of its kind, and the rest stay. Answers them all, as dev.knotless.getPreferences does. Requires authentication: a service token, or the session cookie the pages' login sets, from the pages themselves.

errors.description: A kind of preference the appview does not keep, or one not as its kind says: a theme not named as the pages name theirs, or a reason the appview does not give.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: This appview keeps no index, so it keeps no preferences.
errors.name: NotFound

preferences.description: The preferences to set, at most one of each kind.
